verdict: SIMPLE_GEOMETRY (primary), with a CRITICAL caveat on G4
verdict_summary: The dominant, non-redundant signal is the nearest-target distance (G1). G4 (multi-timeframe liquidity field) and G3 (event-relative) each carry REAL standalone signal vs the bare baseline (M0) — but they are largely REDUNDANT with G1: adding them on top of simple geometry yields no improvement and slightly degrades AUC (collinearity/overfit). OB (B4) remains ~0. Thus case B (conditional increment on top of simple geometry) is NOT supported, but 'G4 is useless / had no data' is also FALSE.

G1_nearest_price.note: SINGLE dominant block. M_G1 alone ~= M_B2_full and is the best model. 15/15 symbols positive (median +0.275). WF-stable (0.825/0.810/0.810).

G2_target_count.note: NEUTRAL. Prior v1.1 'strongly negative' was a pipeline bug artifact (counts wrongly OneHot'd). With correct numeric route G2 adds essentially nothing.

G3_event_relative.note: Real standalone signal, but redundant with G1 (M_B2_full - M_field = G3+G5 increment ~ 0). 15/15 symbols positive.

G4_multitf_field.delta_auc_vs_M0: +0.10 to +0.15 (paired CI all > 0) -- REAL standalone signal
G4_multitf_field.field_vs_simple: M_field - M_simple = G4 on top of G1+G2: deltas -0.009 to -0.034, CI mostly < 0 (NEGATIVE)
G4_multitf_field.note: G4 is NOT empty and NOT useless: it predicts vs baseline. But it is subsumed by the nearest-target distance G1. Adding G4 to G1+G2 does not help and slightly hurts. 15/15 symbols positive standalone (median +0.215).

G5_same_price.delta_auc_vs_M0: +0.014 to +0.039 (small, positive, some WF3 CI includes 0)
G5_same_price.note: Weak positive, not the main story.

mechanical_baseline_repaired.definition: geometry_ratio = min(nearest_above_R, nearest_below_R) / risk_ATR, on RESOLVED-only labels.
mechanical_baseline_repaired.finding: Strong monotone. 0.25ATR: <=0.25 bucket 83.2% delivery vs >2 bucket 26.5%; 1.0ATR: 96.4% vs 43.3%; 3.0ATR: 99.3% vs 49.6%. A single 1-D geometric ratio reproduces most of the model effect.
mechanical_baseline_repaired.implication: The model mainly rediscovers 'target near stop -> easier delivery' physics, not complex SMC theory.

governance.prior_275db5f_conclusions: PROVISIONAL/REPAIRED: G4 UNAVAILABLE (WRONG), G2 strongly negative (WRONG, pipeline bug), SIMPLE_GEOMETRY final (downgraded to SIMPLE_GEOMETRY-with-caveat after repair), bootstrap CI (was invalid, now fixed).

answer_to_users_core_question: Is it simple target distance (A) or multi-timeframe field (B)? PRIMARILY A: the nearest-target distance (G1) dominates and is non-redundant. B is partially true in an absolute sense (G4 has real signal vs baseline) but FALSE in the conditional sense the study targets (G4 adds nothing on top of G1, is subsumed by it). So do not over-engineer: simple geometry + G1 is sufficient; G4 is real but redundant.
